mapper.sql: certification_id, certification_no, tenant_id, merchant_id, product_id, version_no, current_flag, status, source_type, supplier_name, origin_place, shipping_place, match_type, match_value, proof_type, declaration_confirmed, product_snapshot, input_hash, ai_provider, ai_model, prompt_version, ai_decision, confidence, matched_fields, missing_fields, risk_flags, merchant_reason, public_summary, material_valid_until, passed_at, expires_at, attempt_count, next_retry_at, locked_at, last_error, submitted_at, create_by, update_by
mapper.select: select from shop_product_certification where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and product_id = #{productId} order by version_no desc limit 1
select from shop_product_certification where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and product_id = #{productId} and current_flag = '1' limit 1
select from shop_product_certification where certification_id = #{certificationId} and current_flag = '1' and status = 'PROCESSING'

select material_id, tenant_id, certification_id, merchant_id, product_id, material_kind, material_type, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_extension, size_bytes, sha256, page_count, material_sort from shop_product_certification_material where certification_id = #{certificationId} order by material_kind, material_sort, material_id

select material_id, tenant_id, certification_id, merchant_id, product_id, material_kind, material_type, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_extension, size_bytes, sha256, page_count, material_sort from shop_product_certification_material where material_id = #{materialId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: update shop_product_certification set current_flag = null, update_time = sysdate() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and product_id = #{productId} and current_flag = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_product_certification (certification_no, tenant_id, merchant_id, product_id, version_no, current_flag, status, source_type, supplier_name, origin_place, shipping_place, match_type, match_value, proof_type, declaration_confirmed, product_snapshot, input_hash, submitted_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{certificationNo}, #{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{productId}, #{versionNo}, '1', 'PROCESSING', #{sourceType}, #{supplierName}, #{originPlace}, #{shippingPlace}, #{matchType}, #{matchValue}, #{proofType}, '1', #{productSnapshot}, #{inputHash}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())

insert into shop_product_certification_material (tenant_id, certification_id, merchant_id, product_id, material_kind, material_type, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_extension, size_bytes, sha256, page_count, material_sort, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{certificationId}, #{merchantId}, #{productId}, #{materialKind}, #{materialType}, #{originalName}, #{storagePath}, #{contentType}, #{fileExtension}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{pageCount}, #{materialSort}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update shop_product_certification set input_hash = #{inputHash}, update_time = sysdate() where certification_id = #{certificationId} and status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: select certification_id from shop_product_certification where current_flag = '1' and status = 'PROCESSING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= sysdate()) and (locked_at is null or locked_at < #{staleBefore}) order by submitted_at, certification_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update shop_product_certification set locked_at = #{lockedAt}, next_retry_at = null, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, ai_provider = #{aiProvider}, ai_model = #{aiModel}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, last_error = null, update_time = sysdate() where certification_id = #{certificationId} and current_flag = '1' and status = 'PROCESSING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= sysdate()) and (locked_at is null or locked_at < #{staleBefore})

update shop_product_certification set status = #{status}, ai_decision = #{aiDecision}, confidence = #{confidence}, matched_fields = #{matchedFields}, missing_fields = #{missingFields}, risk_flags = #{riskFlags}, merchant_reason = #{merchantReason}, public_summary = #{publicSummary}, material_valid_until = #{materialValidUntil}, passed_at = #{passedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, locked_at = null, next_retry_at = null, last_error = null, update_by = 'product-certification-ai', update_time = sysdate() where certification_id = #{certificationId} and current_flag = '1' and status = 'PROCESSING'

update shop_product_certification set locked_at = null, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = sysdate() where certification_id = #{certificationId} and current_flag = '1' and status = 'PROCESSING'

update shop_product_certification set status = 'EXPIRED', update_by = 'product-certification-expiry', update_time = sysdate() where certification_id = #{certificationId} and current_flag = '1' and status = 'PASSED' and expires_at <= sysdate()

update shop_product_certification set status = 'EXPIRED', locked_at = null, next_retry_at = null, merchant_reason = '商品关键信息已发生变化，请重新申请平台AI认证', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and product_id = #{productId} and current_flag = '1' and status in ('PROCESSING', 'PASSED')
mapper.insert: insert into shop_product_certification_log (tenant_id, certification_id, merchant_id, product_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, event_reason, input_hash, ai_provider, ai_model, prompt_version, operator_type, operator_name, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{certificationId}, #{merchantId}, #{productId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{eventReason}, #{inputHash}, #{aiProvider}, #{aiModel}, #{promptVersion}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorName}, sysdate())
